gaps.sentence: We're thinking of ___ to the coast for the weekend.
Do you want me ___ you at the station?
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want me to meet.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the fence between the two gardens.
gaps.explanation: agree takes the to-infinitive: agreed to mend.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.

gaps.sentence: We'd better not ___ the neighbours again.
gaps.explanation: had better + bare infinitive (not comes after better): better not disturb.
bother + -ing (or to-infinitive): don't bother going. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
I can't wait ___ you the photos.
gaps.explanation: can't wait + to-infinitive: can't wait to show.
